scope: Read-only reassessment of Bar, public Grand Casino and High Limit only, beginning with the published spatial repairs. One new D review JSON is the sole write.

owner_feedback_authority.owner_observation: Bar legs vanish into floor/labels and its counter mass stays wall-flat. Broad felt planes on compressed supports at the wall/floor edge read as shelves/platforms. Evaluate floor depth, whole furniture height, perspective, negative space and contact shadows together.

method.actual_images: Personally viewed the listed unmodified full application populated PNGs, the listed populated1800x860 diagnostic production boards and the current Bar master. No art-only board2x image was used as evidence for actor clearance.
method.capture_review: Viewed explicitly listed original full-app capture samples at their recorded scene clocks. No fresh rendering, animation encoding or APNG playback was performed.
method.coordinate_system: Geometry descriptions are native1800x860 pixels unless noted. Full-app images are1280x720 and include UI/camera framing; apparent physical ratios are visual evidence, not real-world unit measurements.
method.source_identity: Independently rehashed all19/22/21 logical PNG+roomJSON+separate global-index members and compared seals with the published delivery identities. Canonical .import sidecars are outside these established raw-art seal scopes.
method.served_limit: The preserved HTTPS receipts bind delivered bytes, not browser-rendered visuals. All three recorded browser visual/gameplay acceptances are NOT_RUN. No served browser screenshot is asserted and no current TEST pointer/HTTP request was made.

preserve: Every gameplay/model/hit/label/placement anchor, actor scale and camera
All existing animation PNGs, timing, phases, low-detail flags, Reduce Motion and autonomous scheduling
Original saves/profiles and all historical source/evidence
Actual room identity and existing fixed objects; no invented furniture or moved people
common_constraints.failure_standard: A count of opaque support pixels or zero actor intersections does not demonstrate plausible furniture height, room depth or contact. A complete full-room populated composition must read coherently at the actual1280x720 application scale.

rooms.repair_version: Published spatial V4; native settled26/Fight capture and exported7b284648.

concrete_failures.subject: Pool-table height and floor depth
concrete_failures.observation: The broad green surface is clearly visible, but the rail/apron assembly dominates and the legs are squat. The wall/floor boundary runs immediately behind the near part of the table; this reads as a low platform against the wall rather than a full pool table standing within floor depth.
concrete_failures.interpretation: The approximate46px drop below the apron is much shorter than the roughly128px projected tabletop depth. These numbers explain the visual imbalance in the whole room; their ratio is not an automatic acceptance rule.

concrete_failures.subject: Feet, labels and contact shadows
concrete_failures.observation: Base shows the small dark feet against similarly dark wood. In Fight Night, Left-side brawler and Right-side brawler labels occupy the same horizontal band, reducing the already weak support silhouette. Existing local black foot/shadow pixels are present, but they do not provide a readable full-height load path at application scale.
concrete_failures.not_claimed: This is not a claim that support alpha is zero or that every label glyph technically intersects a foot.

concrete_failures.subject: Main bar counter mass
concrete_failures.observation: The front remains a long nearly frontal wooden wall panel under a thin bright ledge. Its painted body ends around468 while floor begins488, leaving a wall strip below it. The stools ground themselves more convincingly than the counter. Strong side/top depth and a cabinet body reaching a credible floor contact are missing.

uncertainties: Only Base, Fight and one later autonomous Fight full-app frame were viewed for this reassessment; all58 sequence cases were not visually re-reviewed.

The current bench starts around604native and Fight actors occupy the lower-right floor. Deeper legs cannot be specified responsibly without their actual silhouettes, perspective order and contact shadows in the same composite.

The present counter replay rectangle and unchanged floor-glint layers may be inadequate for a taller cabinet/body. No new replay bounds, layer change, motion suppression or actor shift is authorized by this review.
Browser composition remains unobserved; exact served bytes do not remove that limit.

one_bounded_composition_correction.name: Recompose the existing lower Bar as one floor/counter/pool-table assembly
one_bounded_composition_correction.direction: Keep the existing pool ball paths and Numbers contact on the same supported green plane, but establish floor behind the furniture and a visibly taller continuous apron-to-leg-to-foot mass. In the same composition, give the existing bar a readable top/side and a full cabinet body that reaches that floor. Retain the existing stools and bench as foreground scale/contact references; mask their actual silhouettes instead of shortening new supports to avoid them.
one_bounded_composition_correction.reopen_prior_art_limits: The old native588 foot cap and112px counter-front crop must not be treated as proof of credible physical height. If a coherent body needs a broader visual mask or replay treatment, root must approve that exact scope after reviewing the whole populated composition.
one_bounded_composition_correction.protected_upper_content: Mirror, signage, dartboard and practical fixture identities remain; no room redesign or new furniture.
one_bounded_composition_correction.acceptance_required: At the ordinary application scale, Base and Fight must show an unbroken load path, intentional floor negative space, readable labels and body/contact shadows belonging to the same floor plane. Then cover the original remaining contexts/motion; numerical clearance alone cannot qualify.

Their perspective identifies a top, but the whole table silhouette still reads as a wall-edge shelf or shallow platform. The floor does not establish enough visible depth behind and beneath the mass.

concrete_failures.observation: Apron and pedestal were fitted into the72px strip below516, with only about52px below the apron. The pedestal is technically connected, but at full-room scale it becomes a small peg under a very wide plane. The negative floor gap is not sufficient evidence of a full-height casino table.

concrete_failures.subject: Scale and shadows with Rourke and the host area
concrete_failures.observation: In Base and Audit, Rourke stands over the left front edge; Gala moves that comparison to the other side of the left table. concrete_failures.not_claimed: No new actor-mask collision, floating-neck gap or missing source alpha is asserted; those were separate earlier concerns.

Changing legs alone will not fix the relationship between the fixed game paint, table edge, standing Rourke and floor horizon. The fixed516 contact and actual cloth/card paint constrain a revised top; do not move or shrink gameplay to make an illustration fit.

A taller body may extend beyond the old588 limit and overlap the global604inlay or foreground host zone. Any occlusion must follow an actual furniture silhouette; erasing the floor stripe as a blanket shadow fix is invalid.
Native and export commits differ. Their recorded source bridge is retained; this review does not make a new Git ancestry or browser-rendering claim.

one_bounded_composition_correction.direction: Preserve all Craps/Blackjack paint, Rourke positions, routes, labels and the existing host station. one_bounded_composition_correction.reopen_prior_art_limits: The fixed72px replay strips and588 maximum body depth are implementation history, not a physical-height acceptance target. rooms.repair_version: Published High Limit spatial V1; nativea9c02a95, exportb35412ac.

concrete_failures.subject: Room depth and table height
concrete_failures.observation: A large uninterrupted wall field ends at the same band as the near tabletop. Both green planes are broad; below their thin fronts are short straight posts. The whole arrangement reads as low platforms against the wall, even though each pair of posts has a complete pixel silhouette.

concrete_failures.subject: Body, negative space and contact shadow
concrete_failures.observation: The dark support gap is visible, but is shallow relative to the top and floor width. Darkening the legs successfully avoided the old bright-cap label issue; it did not establish enough height or table mass. Thin local contact shadows blend with the dark floor, while the strong horizontal inlay below reinforces the platform reading.

concrete_failures.subject: Actual games and foreground scale
concrete_failures.observation: The actual Blackjack/Baccarat paint occupies most of the left top and Roulette occupies the right. The independent center Craps paint and the foreground VIP unit/people show that there is floor depth available, but the background tables are compressed into a shallower vertical zone. These components have not been reconciled into a single convincing perspective.
concrete_failures.not_claimed: The current material audit does not authorize adding a third background table under the live center Craps painter or moving any game/actor.

uncertainties: High Limit Base only was newly viewed, plus one later full-app autonomous frame. This does not establish all actions, interactions or full animation-cycle composition.

The foreground Vega/Kite figures are at different floor depths; their screen height alone cannot define a universal table-height ratio. The FAIL is the combined visual reading, not a numerical height rule.
The untouched floor inlay at602/603 and lower VIP silhouette constrain deeper supports. Their exact occlusion and the unchanged glints/replay must be reviewed before selecting any new body extent.
Existing lamp/sign alpha repairs and reanchors are preserved. They cannot be repurposed to hide the floor/body problem.

one_bounded_composition_correction.direction: Keep the upper room, all9 Base object anchors, existing game paint and all16 motions. Within the lower-room study, establish a floor behind the tables and a coherent tabletop/body/support/contact-shadow system with a visibly greater vertical load path than the current short posts. Evaluate the two tables, independent center game paint, VIP desk and standing people as one full-room composition.
one_bounded_composition_correction.reopen_prior_art_limits: Do not mechanically compress every support into536..588 to preserve the earlier assembly recipe.
